title: Activity to do
description: To have a perfect heart, it must be given by God, and to receive it we must draw near to Him in prayer and by reading His word. So memorize a verse and pray to God twice as long as you usually do!

listChallenge.Tips: I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after My own heart, who will do all My will. Acts 13:22
Set aside a moment alone with God.
